svg.title: CASTAWAY: a hand-built tone pad on the island, dialling CAST AWAY
svg.desc: A blue tone pad with CASTAWAY on red label tape sits on the sand of a sunny island; behind it a young woman in headphones nods under one tall palm. Keys light on the beat with their row and column, a green scope draws each key's two tones and their sum, and a red readout dials 2278 2929, which spells CAST AWAY. She does not answer (headphones). Then it dials 127.0.0.1:8765, which picks up at once, and the D key puts you on hold for a super-rare gag.
